scripts.setup: npm install && composer install && husky install
scripts.build: composer install --no-dev && npm install --only=prod && composer archive --file=$npm_package_name --format=zip && rm -rf build && mkdir -p build/$npm_package_name && unzip -q $npm_package_name.zip -d build/$npm_package_name && rm $npm_package_name.zip && cd build && zip -qr ../$npm_package_name.zip $npm_package_name && cd .. && rm -rf build
